stills.prompt: Vertical 9:16 photograph. A chestnut thoroughbred with a long white blaze down his face walks calmly from right to left along a wet grass racecourse, seen exactly side-on with his left side to the camera, head at the left of frame and tail at the right. He fills the full width of the frame, legs mid-stride: near foreleg reaching forward, opposite hind leg pushing off. His bare shoulder and flank sit in the middle third of the picture as one broad, smooth, unbroken stretch of glossy chestnut coat, evenly lit, with only a plain leather bridle on his head. At the far left edge, just past his muzzle, a dark coat sleeve and a gloved hand hold the bridle. Above him, a pale grey sky and a long grey grandstand far in the distance behind a white running rail; below, dark rain-soaked turf with water beading on the blades. Camera level with his flank, medium distance. Real-looking photograph of an English racecourse on a grey, wet day, soft flat overcast light.

Vertical 9:16 photograph, slightly closer and a touch lower in tone. A chestnut racehorse with a white blaze, side-on with his left side facing us, walks steadily from right to left across soaked green turf, head toward the left edge, tail swinging at the right. His body spans the whole width of the frame, hooves just inside the lower part of the picture, one foreleg lifted and the hind legs staggered in a relaxed walking stride. The centre of the image is his clean, bare shoulder and barrel: a large calm field of rich chestnut coat, damp-sheened from light drizzle, lit evenly with no hard shadows, open and uncluttered from withers to belly. He wears only a simple bridle; a sleeve and hand rest on the cheekpiece at the very left edge beyond his head. Behind him, a white rail runs level across the frame, a misty grey grandstand sits small on the horizon, and a heavy grey sky fills the top. Camera at flank height. Real-looking photograph, English racecourse on a grey, rainy afternoon.

clips.prompt: Starting from the still, a single smooth tracking shot travels sideways alongside the chestnut horse at exactly his walking pace, lens held at the height of his flank, so he stays locked in the same place and size in the frame for all eight seconds. He walks right to left with an unhurried four-beat walk: each hoof lifts, swings forward and sets down softly into the wet grass, hind feet landing close to where the fore feet left. His head nods gently with each step, ears flick, the tail sways. Across his bare shoulder and flank the muscles roll and shift under the smooth chestnut coat, which stays clear and evenly lit in the middle of the frame throughout. The white rail, grey grandstand and wet turf glide steadily past from left to right behind him. One continuous take, steady framing, same angle throughout. Light drizzle, soft grey daylight. Sound: hooves thudding on soft wet grass, one breathy snort, steady rain, a distant crowd murmur, no talking.

Continuing from the opening frame, the camera glides parallel to the walking chestnut horse on a level, stable track, matching his speed so his body holds its exact position and size in the frame from start to finish while the racecourse slides by behind. He moves calmly from right to left, side-on, his left side to us: legs reaching and planting in an easy walk, fetlocks flexing, hooves pressing into the soaked turf; his neck lengthens and draws back with the rhythm of his stride, he gives a small toss of the head and a snort, and his tail swishes once. The wide bare stretch of chestnut coat across his shoulder and flank stays clean and open in the centre of the frame, catching soft overcast light as the muscles beneath it ripple. In the background the white running rail and the distant grey grandstand drift steadily rightward under a grey sky, rain falling lightly. One unbroken shot at flank height. Sound: hooves on soft wet grass, a snort, gentle rain, a faraway crowd, no talking.
